title: A better tail can hide a worse delivery outcome
question: What happens to the latency sample when slow packets are dropped?
observation: The reference capacity-4 case has a 4 μs delivered-packet p99 and 256 drops. Capacity 8 removes drops but has an 8 μs delivered-packet p99.
hypothesis: Survivor-only latency can reward dropping traffic unless delivery is reported alongside it.
nextExperiment: Keep both loss and all-packet completion in every comparison.

title: A trace field is not a verification guarantee
question: What does ARGUS currently mean by verified?
observation: At the reviewed revision, the execution loop accepts non-empty provider text before writing memory.
hypothesis: A visible verification flag can be overinterpreted unless its actual test is documented.
nextExperiment: Planned: distinguish output presence from semantic verification in a future runtime milestone.
